facts.fact: 归巢 22 号——一切开始的地方；Yale 锁加链条双保险。
facts.anchor: We’ve made it back to number twenty-two, where all this madness began.

facts.fact: Luna 对着空气龇牙嘶叫，缩回箱底死活不出来——「上次这样是我初到 Fin……George 的公寓」。
facts.anchor: But she refuses to leave and instead bares her sharp teeth, lowers her head, and continues to hiss into thin air.

facts.fact: 唱机自转：针落黑胶、音量渐大——Blair 也听得见（「Is that fucking Patsy Cline?」）。
facts.anchor: Suddenly, a low crackle makes both of our head’s swivel. I recognise it instantly, the needle hitting the vinyl as it begins to play.

facts.fact: 解读室帘幕拉拢：一根点燃的蜡烛挨着那块最大的玫瑰石英。
facts.anchor: The table is empty apart from one lit pillar candle, sitting next to the hefty chunk of raw rose quartz that cost me more than any crystal ever did.

facts.fact: 灰尘只在半空「中央」处飞舞——像绕着一个看不见的轮廓。
facts.anchor: Dust dances in the air, but it’s only visible around the middle.

facts.fact: 桌首坐着一个男人（像初见那晚）；同一方向一个金发陌生女人缓步逼近。
facts.anchor: At the man sitting at the head of the table, the same way he had that first meeting, or the woman slowly approaching me from the same direction.

facts.fact: 金发陌生人=她当初误认的「失踪前女友」——如今已知不是 Blair。
facts.anchor: The blonde-haired stranger is the same from before. The one I thought was Finlay’s missing ex, Blair. But of course, I know now that can’t be.

facts.fact: 缝住嘴唇的线一根根崩断——嘴张开，说出的还是那个字：RUN。
facts.anchor: I watch each of the stitches that had sewn her lips together snap.
